summary: Browser workbenches use IndexedDB instead of localStorage for project files. Existing cache files and installed posts are copied and verified with their exact originals retained. Controller export commits its saved revision and indexes atomically and reuses an unchanged exact revision on repeat exports. Read-only backup remains available with an editor open, and revision-save errors identify storage recovery instead of suggesting package repair.
warning: Storage compatibility change: older app releases continue to see the preserved pre-migration localStorage snapshot and cannot see newer IndexedDB edits. Avoid editing the old copy. Changed legacy data blocks automatic reconciliation and remains available alongside the database in readable recovery export. External program saves now detect BOM-only outside edits and reject overwriting originals that cannot be read exactly; legacy display remains available. No automatic source, installed package or saved revision deletion or rewrite occurs. Post capabilities, execution events, audit rules and controller-file bytes are unchanged.

checklist.schema: Adds internal browser database version 1 and a staged/active migration receipt. Logical workbench schema 3, project schema 2, UPID, saved revision, machine package, post and journal schemas remain unchanged. Saved-job engine remains 3 and post engine API remains 1.
checklist.events: No execution-event or tool argument changes. Controller generation preserves cancellation and version checks, reports revision-save failures with causeCode and optional path, and may reuse the latest exact validated revision.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Browser persistence requires IndexedDB and the existing Web Locks coordination. Missing coordination retains explicit temporary mode and read-only recovery; denied persistent storage never silently replaces existing data with an empty library.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Normal saved-revision validation, isolated deterministic post execution, motion audit, extension, numbering, encoding, wrappers and line endings remain unchanged. Storage-only failures occur before post execution and cannot authorize changes to machining intent or post capabilities.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Default browser files migrate to IndexedDB through validated staging, exact readback and publication. Exact physical localStorage originals and pending journals are retained; interrupted journal recovery operates only on the destination. Native revision commits compare exact originals atomically and require recovery journals to remain absent; folder operations keep their verified journals. Older apps do not read newer database edits. Read-only backup is separated from restore/cleanup guards. External program loads preserve the legacy display pipeline, but saves require exact originals and reject outside byte changes or unrepresentable encodings before writing.
checklist.verification: Final full Vitest run: 5929/5929 tests in 526 files passed. Chromium: 11 storage/export/recovery journeys and 41 additional CAD/project/DXF/settings journeys passed. Firefox: nine storage/export/recovery journeys passed. Both engines test a real interrupted native revision transaction, unchanged originals, retry, reopen, exact revision reuse and backup with an editor open. Private acceptance compares all 21 original workbench files and preserved cache entries, with the same rose ISO SHA-256 2914868a95f85b73a536540c8b84d4956cb7c2594bda1c74fbddc824a95d39bf. Typecheck, full production build including docs/source distributions, zero-finding lint, ui:check, release check against origin/main, post docs, Robofil 2.6.0 conformance and machine-package validation passed. Independent standards/spec reviews found and fixed exact-text conflicts, thrown pre-write diagnostics, recovery-source isolation and bounded-read races. Software tests do not establish physical machine verification.

publicNotes.summary: Large browser projects can save and export without the localStorage capacity ceiling.
changes: Existing browser projects and installed posts move to a larger browser database while exact originals remain preserved.
Saving an export revision updates its indexes atomically; repeating an unchanged export reuses the exact validated revision.
Download a saved-file backup from an open editor, and get storage-specific recovery guidance when a revision cannot be saved.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed packages, machining intent, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. Older releases see only the preserved earlier cache snapshot, so avoid editing that copy.
publicNotes.action: Keep a downloaded backup. If migration or storage access fails, open Settings → Storage → Export readable recovery files. Do not clear site data to resolve a migration conflict.
